core_claim: The 75-year LEGO catalog is the record of a company that nearly went bankrupt selling toys to children and rebuilt itself by selling much bigger toys to adults — and the inflection shows up in the data more sharply than the company ever advertised.

edt_01.label: The catalog the company didn't keep
edt_01.title: The catalog the company didn't keep
edt_01.editorial_notes: Open with the 'Data Is Plural surfaced this in 2016' framing. Keep the Rebrickable origin to one short paragraph — Nathan Thom, Brisbane, 2011, dark age. Do not turn it into a profile.

edt_02.label: The first half-century (1949–1998)
edt_02.title: The first half-century
edt_02.editorial_notes: Use 1979 Galaxy Explorer and 1984 King's Castle as the era's visual referents. Keep numbers concrete: 5 sets in 1949, 401 in 1998. Median 34 parts in 1980.

edt_03.label: Two bets — Star Wars and Bionicle
edt_03.title: Two bets, 1999–2001
edt_03.editorial_notes: The £100M Bionicle figure is from Wikipedia; keep the qualifier 'about'. Star Wars share has been 3-7% every year — do not round to '~5%' as that loses the steadiness.

edt_04.label: The crater, and the great recolor
edt_04.title: The crater, and the great recolor
edt_04.editorial_notes: ana_06 is the LEAD finding of the whole piece — the 87% single-year drop on old Light Gray. Keep the AFOL term 'bley' visible. The 'interactive' media hint is for a year-by-year color-swatch slider showing the swap; the Designer may downgrade to a stacked-area chart if interactive is overkill, but the per-year transition is the visual.

edt_05.label: Sets got serious
edt_05.title: Sets got serious
edt_05.editorial_notes: The 11,695-piece World Map and the 10,001-piece Eiffel Tower are anchor numbers. Median 34→159 = 4.7x is the headline ratio. Use the Eiffel Tower reference image (det_media_08) and the 2017 UCS Falcon image (det_media_07).

edt_06.label: The pink permission
edt_06.title: The pink permission
edt_06.editorial_notes: The headline contrast is: 1,133 pink parts in Friends sets per year (2024) vs 7,879 in everything else. The Friends launch shifted the palette of every theme, not just the girls' aisle.

edt_07.label: What seventy-five years tell us
edt_07.title: What seventy-five years tell us
edt_07.editorial_notes: End on the AFOL/community frame. The instance placeholder is a strip of the eight reference images from detective.json showing the catalog through time — Galaxy Explorer 1979, King's Castle 1984, UCS TIE 2000, Bionicle Gali 2001, UCS Falcon 2007, Friends 2013, UCS Falcon 2017, Eiffel Tower 2022.
